evidence:
Figure 1 : Alignment drives shared learning and reuse in UniCraft. (a) Robot-specific actions and setting-scoped learning motivate shared
skills across task, embodiment, and benchmark
boundaries (§ 1 ).
(b) UniCraft aligns representations and execution interfaces
(§ 3.1 ) to jointly learn and refine shared
skills and their orchestration policy from multi-episode feedback
(§ 3.2 ). Training mixes 2,700 rollouts per model
across 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments (§ 4.2 ).
The same skills compose across robots via native adapters
(§ 3.3 ).
(c) We comprehensively evaluate UniCraft across 5 benchmarks and
10 embodiments, assessing performance against baselines, skill reuse,
and zero-shot transfer of the same skills and policy to 4 new robots
and 2 unseen benchmarks (§ 4 ).
Transfer cells show robosuite at 2,000 simulation steps (Gem.: Gemini; DS: DeepSeek;
MM: MiniMax).
